title: Payroll stub calculation and ledger posting
name: Payroll stub calculator

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code loads and applies the monetary rates used for pay? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
An employee with an hourly rate of 20.00 works 45 hours and the overtime multiplier is 1.5. What gross pay does compute_stub produce?
Why does compute_stub derive net as gross - withholding rather than rounding gross * (1 - withholding_rate) separately?
choices: It is faster than a multiplication.
It makes withholding and net always add up to exactly the gross, so the three journal entries cannot be off by a rounding cent.
to_cents would raise on a product with more than two decimals.

questions.prompt: A caller passes hours=37.5 as a Python float to compute_stub. What happens?
choices: The result is computed with float precision and then rounded to cents.
A ValueError is raised by the negative-hours check.
The float is silently converted by Decimal and the calculation proceeds exactly.
A TypeError is raised, because Decimal arithmetic does not accept a float operand.
